findings.evidence: Post-PR `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Induction/FiniteDimensional.lean:306` `def indFDRep {k : Type u} {G : Type v}` and `Induction/Character.lean:209,223` `variable {k : Type u} {G : Type v}` / `theorem ClassFunction.ind_ofFDRep`. `grep -rn "same universe|one universe" TauCeti/RepresentationTheory` shows Artin.lean:59,61 is the only place in the repo documenting this restriction.
findings.fix: Split Artin.lean to `variable {k : Type u} {G : Type v}` and drop the note; every dependency it names is already two-universe (`Spanning.lean:117` `(k : Type u) (G : Type v)`, `CharacterTable/Table.lean:318-323` `basisIrreducibleCharacter (k : Type u) (G : Type v)`, and `ind_ofFDRep_mem_virtualCharacters` after this PR). If some other declaration still forces the restriction, name that one instead.
findings.issue: The implementation note says "`k` and `G` lie in the same universe here ... because the FDRep-level induction API used here (`TauCeti.indFDRep` and `TauCeti.ClassFunction.ind_ofFDRep`) is currently stated in one universe." This PR makes both of those two-universe, so the note is now false and the `variable {k G : Type u}` at line 163 has no stated justification left.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Shrink.lean:18,27`: `variable {R α : Type*} [Small.{v} α] [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid α] [Module R α]` / `def linearEquiv : Shrink.{v} α ≃ₗ[R] α`. `Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Equiv/Basic.lean:587` `conjRingEquiv` is at the same level, and `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Intertwining.lean:26,310,326` puts `Representation.Equiv` and `Equiv.mk` at `[Semiring A] [Monoid G] [AddCommMonoid V]`.
findings.fix: State it as `{k : Type u} {G : Type v} {V : Type w} [CommSemiring k] [Monoid G] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module k V] [Small.{u} V] (ρ : Representation k G V)`; the body is unchanged, and `indSmallModel` still applies it at `Field`/`Group`.
findings.issue: `shrinkRepEquiv` assumes `[Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V]`; nothing in its statement or its `apply/intro/ext/simp` proof uses invertibility, inverses, or subtraction. This is the same over-assumption already corrected on the sibling new declarations `moduleFinite_forgetFDRep` (line 264) and `forget₂_map_forget₂HomLinearEquiv` (line 327), both of which the author stated at `[CommRing R] [Monoid G]`.

summary: The universe split itself sits at the natural level and the prior finding on the two forgetFDRep declarations is resolved. Two gaps remain: Artin.lean still carries a note asserting the exact limitation this PR removes (and the restriction it justifies), and the new private helper shrinkRepEquiv keeps Field/Group/AddCommGroup where Semiring/Monoid/AddCommMonoid suffice.
